properties.content:

Nearest City: Pine Bluff, AR

Incident Type: STORAGE TANK

Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: L & R DISTRIBUTORS/ SAJ
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 34.197518, -92.039125 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 2 gallon
Report Description
CALLER IS REPORTING THAT A FORKLIFT DRIVER PUNCTURED A HYDROCHLORIC ACID PALLET THAT CONTAINED SEVERAL JUGS. APPROXIMATELY 2 OF THE JUGS DISCHARGED THE ACID ONTO THE GROUND AND THEY WERE INSTRUCTED TO CLEAN UP THE DISCHARGE WITHOUT PROPER EQUIPMENT (I.E. GLOVES, MASK, ETC). ALL THAT WAS APPLIED TO THE DISCHARGE WAS KITTY LITTER AND THEY PLACED THE LITTER INTO PLASTIC BAGS. THERE IS STILL A VERY STRONG ODOR FROM WHERE THE DISCHARGE OCCURRED. AFTER MANAGEMENT WAS MADE AWARE THAT SOMEONE CALLED OSHA, THEY TAPED OFF THE AREA AND TOLD EMPLOYEES THAT THEY COULD NOT ENTER THE AREA, EVEN THOUGH THEY WERE JUST THERE AND CLEANED UP THE MATERIAL WITHOUT PROPER PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT PRIOR.

Report Description/// NOAA/NESDIS MPSR ISSUED FOR: GULF OF AMERICA /// POSSIBLE, UNCONFIRMED OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. REPORT DATE: 06-03-2025 REPORT TIME: 0345 UTC REGION: GULF OF AMERICA SUB REGION: N/A AREA/BLOCK: SOUTH PASS 5 IMAGE DATE: 06-02-2025 IMAGE TIME: 1704 UTC DATA SOURCE: PLANETSCOPE MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 3 METER LOCATION: 29°08"17" N/89°00"53" W AREA: 44.70 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM-HIGH REPORT MAP/GIS FILES: HTTPS://WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/ REMARKS: POSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE LARGE SLICK SPANNED OVER APPROXIMATELY 21.22 NM AND APPROX. 6.96 NM AT ITS WIDEST. IT DID NOT TEST POSITIVE OR RESEMBLE VEGETATION. IT WAS DISTINCT FROM NATURAL PHENOMENA DUE TO ITS LARGE AND UNNATURAL SHAPE. IT WAS MOSTLY SHIMMERY WITH WHITE CENTERS SPREAD THROUGHOUT WHICH INDICATED THE PRESENCE OF RELATIVELY THICKER OIL. WINDS NEAR THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE COMING FROM THE E AT 8 KT WHICH ALIGNED WELL WITH THE ORIENTATION OF THE SLICK. UNCERTAINTIES: THE FULL EXTENT OF THE SLICK WAS UNKNOWN DUE TO THE SATELLITE IMAGE BEING CUT OFF TOWARDS THE EAST. THERE WERE OTHER SUSPICIOUS SLICKS TOWARDS THE WEST THAT SEEMED TO MERGE WITH THIS LARGE ONE. AS FOR THE POINT SOURCE, THERE WERE VARIOUS OIL FACILITIES, WELLS, AND PIPELINES WITHIN THE VICINITY WHICH MADE IT DIFFICULT TO PINPOINT A SPECIFIC ORIGIN. THERE WAS AN OIL FACILITY TOWARDS THE NORTHERN END OF THE SLICK THAT WAS VISIBLY CONNECTED.

REPORT DATE: 06-03-2025 REPORT TIME: 0345 UTC REGION: GULF OF AMERICA SUB REGION: N/A AREA/BLOCK: SOUTH PASS 5 IMAGE DATE: 06-02-2025 IMAGE TIME: 1704 UTC DATA SOURCE: PLANETSCOPE MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 3 METER LOCATION: 29°08"17" N/89°00"53" W AREA: 44.70 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM-HIGH REPORT MAP/GIS FILES: HTTPS://WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/ REMARKS: POSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE LARGE SLICK SPANNED OVER APPROXIMATELY 21.22 NM AND APPROX. 6.96 NM AT ITS WIDEST. IT DID NOT TEST POSITIVE OR RESEMBLE VEGETATION. IT WAS DISTINCT FROM NATURAL PHENOMENA DUE TO ITS LARGE AND UNNATURAL SHAPE. IT WAS MOSTLY SHIMMERY WITH WHITE CENTERS SPREAD THROUGHOUT WHICH INDICATED THE PRESENCE OF RELATIVELY THICKER OIL. WINDS NEAR THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE COMING FROM THE E AT 8 KT WHICH ALIGNED WELL WITH THE ORIENTATION OF THE SLICK. UNCERTAINTIES: THE FULL EXTENT OF THE SLICK WAS UNKNOWN DUE TO THE SATELLITE IMAGE BEING CUT OFF TOWARDS THE EAST. THERE WERE OTHER SUSPICIOUS SLICKS TOWARDS THE WEST THAT SEEMED TO MERGE WITH THIS LARGE ONE. AS FOR THE POINT SOURCE, THERE WERE VARIOUS OIL FACILITIES, WELLS, AND PIPELINES WITHIN THE VICINITY WHICH MADE IT DIFFICULT TO PINPOINT A SPECIFIC ORIGIN. THERE WAS AN OIL FACILITY TOWARDS THE NORTHERN END OF THE SLICK THAT WAS VISIBLY CONNECTED.

THIS CAUSED THE TANK'S PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE TO OPEN BRIEFLY TO RELIEVE PRESSURE. THE AMOUNT OF AMMONIA RELEASED AT THAT TIME WAS ABOUT 40 LBS. IT WAS BELIEVED THAT THIS VALVE RE-SEATED ITSELF AS DESIGNED. AT ABOUT 12:45 P.M., IT WAS DISCOVERED THAT THE RELIEF VALVE HAD MALFUNCTIONED AND FAILED TO PROPERLY RE-SEAT ITSELF. THE LEAK WAS STOPPED AT APPROXIMATELY 2:45 P.M. AND EMISSION ESTIMATES WERE PERFORMED AT THAT TIME. EXCEEDANCE OF THE REPORTABLE QUANTITY PROBABLY OCCURRED NO EARLIER THAN 1:00 P.M.

THE REEFER CAR WAS SHUT DOWN AND THE LEAK STOPPED.
